meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.trans: The mayor came up with a new plan.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.
I have no money at all.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.note: других вариантов нет = there are no other options

examples.text: Пробуем, других вариантов у нас нет.
examples.trans: Let's try it, we have no other options.

examples.text: Это самый лучший вариант для всех.
examples.trans: This is the very best option for everyone.

meanings.note: agrees in gender and case with the noun

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.

meanings.note: мы вдвоём = the two of us

examples.trans: The two of us live together.
Let's celebrate just the two of us.
That was a very subtle move.

examples.text: У нее тонкий вкус в искусстве.
examples.trans: She has delicate taste in art.

поехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to set off

meanings.en: to go, to set off (by car, bus, train)

meanings.note: act of buying or item bought

examples.text: Это договор на покупку строительного оборудования.
examples.trans: This is a contract for the purchase of construction equipment.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.note: the person who likes is in the dative: мне нравится = I like it

examples.trans: I know this town really well!
